sourceRecords.title: ScottishPower Renewables Files for Planning Consent for 3 GW Floating Wind Farm
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that ScottishPower Renewables submitted offshore and onshore consent applications for the 3 GW MarramWind floating wind project in Scotland. The source states that the offshore application, including the Environmental Impact Assessment, went to the Scottish Government Marine Directorate.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

briefingItems.title: MarramWind consent applications submitted
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: ScottishPower Renewables submitted onshore and offshore consent applications for the 3 GW MarramWind project.
briefingItems.explanation: The source identifies a consenting step for a large floating wind project located about 75 kilometres off northeast Scotland.
